meta.title: Perpetual Bloom and her Frozen Witness
meta.subtitle: A novel in twenty-one chapters
meta.tagline: Some love stories are kept in objects; this one is kept in frost and bloom.
meta.description: A luminous, object-haunted love story told across twenty-one chapters, where memory, monsoon light and small kept things gather into a witness.
meta.openingQuote: You came, you saw, and somehow you conquered the part of me that had forgotten how to be gentle.

credits.artwork: Original SVG artwork made for this edition
credits.soundtrack: Generative WebAudio palettes, one per chapter

notes: Chapter titles and word counts follow the printed chapter headings.
Chapter 20 belongs to Act IV although no act label is printed above it.
The opening quote is transcribed from Chapter 1.
All artwork is original SVG and works offline.

acts.title: Prologue
acts.subtitle: The book and the arrow
acts.blurb: Before the acts begin, a manuscript waits under a paper crane and a summer train carries a confession toward the sea.

acts.title: The Arrival
acts.subtitle: Clover, earbuds, and the minute at 7:02
acts.blurb: The ordinary office becomes luminous as small objects start keeping time: a clover, a pair of earbuds, a hair clip in the rain.

acts.title: The Accumulation
acts.subtitle: Cups, sparrows, and things kept
acts.blurb: Days accumulate into relics. Shared sips, morning sparrows and folded notes make a private museum of a July.

acts.title: The Relics
acts.subtitle: What the petals remember
acts.blurb: The light thins. Bracelets, petals, a metro window and a pocket-sized penguin hold what the calendar cannot.

acts.title: The Turning
acts.subtitle: The letter and the final fold
acts.blurb: A minute returns, a letter crosses distance, and a last crane is folded with the patience of something that means to stay.
